# Table → KVKK provider map (01 §3.3, T-92; BE-021). TestEveryPersonalTableHasProvider
# reads it together with every CREATE TABLE of db/migrations:
#
#   <table>  <class>  <owner module>  <coverage>
#
# class     personal | special (KVKK md. 6) | staff (only staff/author user references,
#           02 §0.6 "yok") | none (02 §0.6 "yok")
# coverage  provider:<name>    a registered privacy.Provider exports and erases the table
#           todo:BE-NNN        the module has no code yet; its ticket registers the provider
#           exempt:<reason>    personal but deliberately outside every provider (≥ 20 characters)
#           -                  staff/none tables
#
# A new table without a line, a personal table without coverage, a provider name that is
# not registered, or a table with a user column classified none fails the test. A module
# ticket that adds its provider turns its todo lines into provider lines.

# platform (operational, short retention swept by the platform jobs)
outbox                      personal  platform      exempt:payload holds IDs only; deleted 7 days after publication (outbox_published)
webhook_inbox               personal  platform      exempt:provider payloads; nulled after 90 days, rows deleted after 2 years (webhook_payload/row)
idempotency_keys            personal  platform      exempt:stored responses expire after 24 hours (idempotency)
# audit (append-only hash chain: rows keep the tombstone UUID, never erased)
audit_events                personal  audit         exempt:append-only hash chain; actor stays the tombstone UUID, purged after 2 years (audit_events)
audit_daily_roots           none      audit         -
# files
files                       personal  files         provider:files
# consent
consent_purposes            none      consent       -
notice_versions             staff     consent       -
